name: King of Bugs
summary:
Embark on a captivating adventure with "King of Bugs", a tower defense game that takes you deep into the heart of the ant kingdom. King Karl leads his ants on a journey through a magical forest teeming with evil bugs as he seeks a new home for his people.

In this base defense strategy game, you'll experience a unique blend of tower defense dynamics. Defend the king against waves of bugs, deploying a variety of defense strategies and upgrading Karl's armor, sword, and protective fences to shield him from the insect onslaught.

The game offers a rich storyline, combining elements of love, courage and deceit within the ant kingdom. Immerse yourself in a cartoonish yet vibrant world, filled with colorful art and memorable characters. Engage in epic battles and clash with various bug adversaries, each level bringing new challenges and boss battles.

As you progress through levels, you can improve Karl's gear and unlock new abilities. Utilize a variety of different turrets driven by ants, with four kinds of towers, each tower featuring several upgrades. Every upgrade opens up new tactical possibilities, allowing you to craft a unique strategy for each level.
